ompany would be required to meet the stipulate d turnover requirements as above, provided that the Net Worth of such Hold ing Company as on the last day of the preceding financial year is at least eq ual to or m ore than the paid-up share capital of the Holding Company. In cases where audited results for the last financial year as on the date of Tech no-Commercial bid opening are not available, the financial results certified by a practicing Ch ar tered Accountant shall also be considered acce table. In case, Bidder is not able to submit the Certificat e from a practicing Chartered Accountant certifying its financial para meters, the audited results of three c onsecutive financial years preceding the l ast financial year shall be considered for evaluating the financial parameters. F urther, a Certificate would be required from the CEO/CFO as per the format enc losed in the bidding documents stating that the financial results of the Compan y are under audit as on the date of Tec hno-Commercial bid opening and the Ce rtificate from the practicing Chartered Accountant certifying the fi nancial para meters is not available. (ii) "Holding Company" and "Subsidiary Company" shall have the meaning ascribed to them as per Compa nies Act of India. (iii) Net worth means the sum total of the paid-up share capital and free reserves. Free reserves means all reserves credited out of the profits and share premium account but does not include reserves credited out of the revaluation of the assets, write back of depreciation provision and amalgamation. Further any debit balance of Profit and Loss account and miscellaneous expenses to the extent not adjusted or written off, if any, shall be reduced from reserves and surplus. For Turnover indicated in foreign currency, the exchange rate as on seven (07) days prior to the date of techno- commercial bid opening shall be used. TAKE OFF LIFTING SYSTEM-24 TON with Synchronized 02 number Geared motor connected with PI dives with a single sha , compact in size, mounted between the Bend pulleys. 2. Vertical PI drive and TECDOS chain with two strand and two parallel drives. 3. The system is driven by two synchronized motors with end fastener attached to the counterweight and l oad limiters at respective ends. 4. Variable speed control with special VFD, The Variable frequency drive helps in controlling the complete s ystem.

5. Self-cleaning components. 6. Overload protec on with the help of special brake motor with DBR locking system & power cut off. 7. TECDOS chain use along with end fastener to connected with counterweight. 8. Design &Safety factor as per Design Acc. To = DIN EN 13155 or ISO 17096:2015. 9. Vendors must supply material along with accessories as per site suitability and fitment. 10.supervision for installaon of material at locaon will be in scope of vendor, manpower support will be pro vided by PVUNL within TWO month of receiving material at site. 11. 70% Payment will be release a er receiving of material at site &30% a er successful installaon and loa dt esng of system. 12. Vendor shall arrange Test cerficate from Government approved testing / third-party load testing of the installed Take-Off Li ing System. The cost incurred for the same will be under the vendor’s scope. 13. Warranty guarantee clauses-18 month from date of supply or 12 month from date of installation which ever earlier. . 4.
